wikibaseimport-summary: Intro text on Special:WikibaseImport. Import-as-new leaves a living page unchanged and recreates a deleted mapped id. Extend mode updates a local id the user types and does not match by label or description.
wikibaseimport-operation-label: Legend for the import mode radios on Special:WikibaseImport.
wikibaseimport-operation-new: Radio label for creating a new local entity.
wikibaseimport-operation-new-help: Help text for the import-as-new radio. The mapping table stores source id to local id.
wikibaseimport-operation-extend: Radio label for supplementing an existing local entity from a source id on wikidata.org.
wikibaseimport-operation-extend-help: Help text for the extend radio. Both ids are typed by the user.
wikibaseimport-local-entity-label: Label for the local entity id field. Shown only in extend mode.
wikibaseimport-local-entity-description: Help text for the local entity id field.
wikibaseimport-replace-description-label: Checkbox label for replacing descriptions. Default off. Shown only in extend mode.
wikibaseimport-replace-description-descr: Help text for the replace-description checkbox. Per language: keep an existing description when off, overwrite languages present on the source when on, never delete a language the source does not have.
wikibaseimport-add-aliases-label: Checkbox label for adding missing aliases. Default on in extend mode.
wikibaseimport-add-aliases-description: Help text for the add-aliases checkbox. Exact string match within one language. Local aliases are never deleted.
wikibaseimport-entity-label: Label for the source entity id field.
wikibaseimport-entity-description: Help text for the source entity id field.
wikibaseimport-user-label: Label for the local account field.
wikibaseimport-user-description: Help text for the local account field. WBImportUser is the configuration setting name.
wikibaseimport-statements-description: Help text for the statements checkbox.
wikibaseimport-sitelinks-description: Help text for the sitelinks checkbox.
wikibaseimport-import: Button that runs the import. Hidden until a check passes.
wikibaseimport-pending-check: Status text while the dry-run request is in progress.
wikibaseimport-pending-import: Status text while the import request is in progress.
wikibaseimport-check-ok:
Success message after a dry-run with no errors or warnings.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of source entities
* $2 - local user name, with the bot flag already appended when relevant
wikibaseimport-check-warn:
Warning message after a dry-run that logged warnings but no errors.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of source entities
* $2 - local user name, with the bot flag already appended when relevant
wikibaseimport-check-error: Error message when a dry-run fails.
wikibaseimport-import-ok:
Success message after an import with no errors or warnings.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of source entities requested
* $2 - local user name, with the bot flag already appended when relevant
wikibaseimport-import-warn:
Warning message after an import that logged warnings but no errors.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of source entities requested
* $2 - local user name, with the bot flag already appended when relevant
wikibaseimport-import-error: Error message when an import logs errors or fails.
wikibaseimport-bot-flag: Appended to the user name when that account has the bot right. Leading space is intentional.
wikibaseimport-mode-statements: Second line of the result message when statements will be copied.
wikibaseimport-mode-terms: Second line of the result message when only terms are copied.
wikibaseimport-related-count:
Shown under the result message when statements are copied and extra entities are part of the run.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of entities besides the requested source ids
wikibaseimport-mode-mismatch:
Error when the dry-run flags do not match the checkboxes. Import stays hidden.

Parameters:
* $1 - server value for Copy statements, {{msg-mw|wikibaseimport-on}} or {{msg-mw|wikibaseimport-off}}
* $2 - form value for Copy statements
* $3 - server value for Keep sitelinks
* $4 - form value for Keep sitelinks
wikibaseimport-on: Word used for a checked checkbox in {{msg-mw|wikibaseimport-mode-mismatch}}.
wikibaseimport-off: Word used for an unchecked checkbox in {{msg-mw|wikibaseimport-mode-mismatch}}.
wikibaseimport-col-id: Table column for the source entity id.
wikibaseimport-col-label: Table column for the source label.
wikibaseimport-col-action: Table column for create, exists, created, recreate or recreated.
wikibaseimport-col-terms: Table column for label, description and alias counts.
wikibaseimport-col-statements: Table column for the statement summary.
wikibaseimport-col-sitelinks: Table column for the sitelink summary.
wikibaseimport-col-local: Table column for the local entity id.
wikibaseimport-action-create: Table cell when the dry-run would create the entity.
wikibaseimport-action-exists: Table cell when the entity was imported before.
wikibaseimport-action-created: Table cell after the entity was created.
wikibaseimport-action-recreate: Table cell when the dry-run would create the mapped local page again because that page was deleted. The archived revision is not restored.
wikibaseimport-action-recreated: Table cell after the deleted local page was created again at the same id.
wikibaseimport-action-statements: Table cell when statements were already imported.
wikibaseimport-action-extend: Table cell when the dry-run would supplement an existing local entity.
wikibaseimport-action-extended: Table cell after an existing local entity was supplemented.
wikibaseimport-statements-plan:
Statement counts in the table.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of statements that would be written or were written
* $2 - number of statements skipped
wikibaseimport-statements-extend:
Statement counts for extend mode.

Parameters:
* $1 - statements added because the property, main snak and rank were new
* $2 - existing statements that gained qualifiers or references
* $3 - source statements that could not be mapped
wikibaseimport-extend-button: Label of the import button while extend mode is selected.
wikibaseimport-mode-extend:
Extra result line in extend mode.

Parameters:
* $1 - local entity id
* $2 - source entity id
wikibaseimport-extend-mismatch: Error when the dry-run extend options do not match the form. Import stays hidden.
wikibaseimport-empty-entity: Error when the entity field is empty.
wikibaseimport-empty-local: Error when extend mode is selected and the local entity field is empty.
wikibaseimport-bad-id: Error when an extend-mode id is not an item or property id.
wikibaseimport-id-mismatch: Error when one extend-mode id is an item and the other is a property.
wikibaseimport-local-missing:
Error when the local id does not exist. Extend mode does not create it.

Parameters:
* $1 - local entity id
wikibaseimport-local-redirect:
Error when the local id is a redirect.

Parameters:
* $1 - local entity id
wikibaseimport-source-missing:
Error when the source id is missing on the source wiki.

Parameters:
* $1 - source entity id
wikibaseimport-request-failed: Fallback error when the API request fails without a message.
wikibaseimport-stale: Error when Import is clicked after the form changed.
wikibaseimport-hotbox-title: Title of the collapsed extend control on a local item or property page.
wikibaseimport-hotbox-terms-only: Hint under the extend control. Statements and sitelinks are not copied from this control.
wikibaseimport-hotbox-check-ok:
Success line after a dry-run on the entity page.

Parameters:
* $1 - source entity id
wikibaseimport-hotbox-import-ok:
Success line after extend on the entity page. The page reloads when there are no warnings.

Parameters:
* $1 - source entity id
wikibaseimport-hotbox-labels:
Count of labels that would be added, or were added.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of labels
wikibaseimport-hotbox-descriptions:
Count of descriptions added in languages the local entity did not have.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of descriptions
wikibaseimport-hotbox-replaced:
Count of descriptions overwritten because replace description is on.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of descriptions
wikibaseimport-hotbox-aliases:
Count of aliases that would be added, or were added.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of aliases
wikibaseimport-hotbox-delta-none: Shown when the dry-run or extend would not change labels, descriptions or aliases.
wikibaseimport-hotbox-warnings: Fallback when the run has warnings but no warning line was returned.
